decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The brick piers hereby permitted shall be constructed with the mortar flush to the brickwork.

Condition : 5 - The proposed application is considered not to have an adverse affect upon the amenities of adjoining residential occupiers and is considered to preserve and enhance the surrounding Conservation Area. This is in accordance with policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the adopted London Borough Of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Removal of existing entrance piers and gates to Ridegway Road frontage and erection of new piers in a style and design to replicate the originals. Widening of existing accesses and gates to Church Road frontage.  Removal of existing railings to Ridgeway and Church Road frontages and erection of a 2.0m high railings to site.
